Name: Oreb, Prince of Midian
Summary: Oreb, a prince of Midian, was captured and killed by Ephraim at the rock Oreb during Gideon's victory.
KeyStory: After Gideon's night attack, Ephraim took the waters and slew Oreb at the rock Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Zeeb, Prince of Midian; Zebah, King of Midian; Zalmunna, King of Midian
LifeLesson: Princes fall where the battle turns, and the rock keeps their name.
